lines.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the church of the Thessalonians, wishing them grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul thanks God because their faith is growing, and he boasts about their perseverance among God's churches despite persecution.
God will repay with affliction those who afflict them and grant relief to the oppressed when Jesus is revealed from Jerusalem.
Jesus will inflict vengeance in blazing fire on those who do not know God, and they will suffer eternal destruction.
Paul prays that God will count them worthy of His honor, so that the name of Jesus will be glorified in them.
